card.name: Words just before an expected drug or action
card.fires_on: Scattered words in warning and interaction text, often right before a known next word or phrase, such as the in of warfarin, the in before pediatric patients, or the start of Administer and Initiate.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: Partway through warfarin, where the rest of the name is predictable.

modes.label: Linking word before patients or action
modes.description: Small words such as in, to, or a comma that come before a patient group or a monitoring or treatment step.

modes.label: Start of an instruction verb
modes.description: The start of a management verb like Administer or Initiate at the beginning of a sentence.
modes.example: Restart XPOVIO at 1 dose level lower (see Table 1 ). Admin<<ister>> blood transfusions per clinical guidelines.
